name: How quickly can you respond to an emergency storm cleanup call?

mainEntity.name: How quickly can you respond to an emergency storm cleanup call?

acceptedAnswer.text: We understand the urgency of storm damage and aim to respond rapidly to emergency cleanup calls. Our team is available 24/7, and we strive to be on-site as quickly as possible, often within a few hours, depending on your location and the severity of the widespread damage. A prompt response helps to minimize further damage and initiate the recovery process sooner.
acceptedAnswer.description: We respond rapidly, often within a few hours, to emergency storm cleanup calls, as our team is available 24/7.
